title: SelectorOutput
description: Schema for the selector's structured output (Pass 1 row #119). The MVP `fixed` strategy is degenerate — the active_deliberation_panel equals the declared default_deliberation_panel and the coordinator_agent equals config.selector.coordinator_agent, so a SelectorOutput is trivially derivable from Config without invocation. This schema is provided for v1+ strategies (`rules`, `llm`) so adapters can serialize selector decisions for replay and audit. Fields beyond the MVP-degenerate set are marked [v1].

strategy.description: Which selector strategy produced this output. Matches Config.selector.strategy.

selected_agents.description: Ordered list of agent ids forming the active_deliberation_panel for this session.

coordinator_agent.description: Agent id of the chosen coordinator.

excluded_agents.description: [v1] Agents the selector considered but declined to include, with rationale.

missing_capabilities.description: [v1] Capability gaps the selector identified for which no available persona fits. Surfaced for offline persona-creation workflow (Pass 1 row #124).

suggested_persona.description: Suggested persona id to fill the gap, if obvious.

reasoning.description: [v1] Free-text rationale for the selection decision (LLM strategies only).
